Name: Dragon's Tear
Description: A crystallized tear shed by a dragon. Said to contain the essence of draconic vitality and regeneration. Extremely rare.

Name: Throwing Daggers
Description: A pack used by Hidden Blade. Daggers remaining: 10.

Name: Armor Piercing Bolts
Description: Hardened bolts that ignore armor. Bolts remaining: 10.

Name: Delayed Bolts
Description: Bolts that explode one turn after attaching. Bolts remaining: 10.

Name: Heat-Seeking Bolts
Description: Bolts that curve toward warm targets. Bolts remaining: 10.

Name: Magic Bolts
Description: Arcane ammunition for a Magic Crossbow. Bolts remaining: 10.

Name: Metal Bolts
Description: Durable ammunition with a high recovery chance. Bolts remaining: 10.

Name: Napalm Bolts
Description: Explosive bolts that spread burning material. Bolts remaining: 10.

Name: Wooden Bolts
Description: Fragile wooden crossbow ammunition. Bolts remaining: 10.

Name: Cryptic Key
Description: A pristine key forged by Griswold. Its purpose is shrouded in mystery, but it feels important.

Name: Key
Description: Unlocks a locked chest but is consumed.

Name: Master Key
Description: Unlocks doors that may lead to either valuable treasure or to powerful enemies.

Name: Old Key
Description: Unlocks doors that may lead to either valuable treasure or to powerful enemies.

Name: Censer of Choking Ash
Description: A reusable censer that blankets the surrounding area in choking smoke. Required to cast Obscuration.

Name: Oculus
Description: An expensive arcane lens that reveals the telltale shimmer of fake walls.

Name: Bird Fat
Description: The fat from a bird, used as a fuel for lamps.

Name: Cursed Hops
Description: Hops from a cursed tree, these flower are used primarily in the creation of beer and other beverages, as well as herbal medicines.

Name: Dead Soldier
Description: The partially eaten body of a very green soldier. He never stood a chance...

Name: Elemental Mote
Description: The elemental core of a Myrmidon.

Name: Feather
Description: The feather of a bird.

Name: Jester Token
Description: A carnival token that shimmers with magical energy. These are required to breach the Jester's inner sanctum.

Name: Leather
Description: The dried skin of an animal, used for various purposes.

Name: Mystery Meat
Description: Unknown meat with a strange smell. Maybe you could do something with this.

Name: Phylactery
Description: The soul artifcat of a Lich, given up willingly to achieve immortality.

Name: Power Core
Description: The power source of a Golem.

Name: Rat Tail
Description: The tail of a rat.

Name: Scrap Metal
Description: A chunk of metal.

Name: Snake Skin
Description: The skin of a snake.

Name: Ticket Piece
Description: A scrap of a lottery ticket with a few numbers on it.

Name: Acorn
Description: A hardy oak seed prized by druids for growth rites.

Name: Fungus Spore
Description: A powdery spore bundle useful in poison and decay rites.

Name: Hemlock Root
Description: A bitter root gathered for dangerous druidic mixtures.

Name: Reality Fragment
Description: A splinter of impossible matter. Thaumaturgists consume it to force a Miracle past the ordinary laws of conjuration.

Name: Soul Gem
Description: A crystallized soul used to barter for stronger fiend-contract outcomes.

Name: Vine Seed
Description: A coiled seed that hums with grasping green life.

Name: Blank Scroll
Description: A prepared scroll with enough receptive ink to hold one stolen spell.

Name: Bless Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast Bless, which increases attack damage for several turns. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Boost Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the heal spell Boost. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Cleanse Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the holy spell Cleanse. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Death Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast Desoul, which can kill the target. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Dispel Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast Dispel, which can remove all positive status effects from the target. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Earth Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the earth spell Tremor. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Electric Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the electric spell Shock. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Fire Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the fire spell Firebolt. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Holy Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the holy spell Holy. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Ice Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the ice spell Ice Lance. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Photon Sphere Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the powerful Photon Sphere. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Sanctuary Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast Sanctuary, which can return the user to town. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Scroll
Description: Base class for scrolls.

Name: Shadow Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the shadow spell Shadow Bolt. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Sheet Music: Battle Hymn
Description: A martial hymn for battle.

Name: Sheet Music: Bones, Thugs, and Harmony
Description: A graveyard harmony.

Name: Sheet Music: Chorus Time
Description: A looping chorus.

Name: Sheet Music: Gold Trigger
Description: A glittering trigger phrase.

Name: Sheet Music: Low-defense-ian Rhapsody
Description: A tune that lowers defenses.

Name: Sheet Music: Ode to the Ramparts
Description: A protective ode.

Name: Sheet Music: Scores and Scores Score
Description: A score about scoring.

Name: Sheet Music: Slow Ride
Description: A dragging song.

Name: Sheet Music: Symphony of Disfunction
Description: A discordant enemy-breaking score.

Name: Shell Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the heal spell Shell. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Silence Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast Silence, which can prevent an target from casting spell for a time. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Sleep Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast Sleep. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Stolen Magic Missile Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with a stolen copy of Magic Missile. Charges: 5. The scroll crumbles when its charges run out.

Name: Water Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the water spell Water Jet. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Wind Scroll
Description: Scroll inscribed with an incantation allowing the user to cast the wind spell Gust. The scroll will be consumed when it is out of charges.

Name: Brass Key
Description: A brass key, similar to the key for your storage locker in the barracks.

Name: Chalice Map
Description: A weathered map whose ink appears almost completely faded.

Name: Draconite
Description: A red-black shard from Kaelenon's home realm, warm with restored draconic power.

Name: Empty Vial
Description: An empty vial, perfect for storing liquids and other tinctures.

Name: Excaliper
Description: The broken fragments of a failed experiment. It appears someone tried to forge the legendary sword Excalibur using a caliper tool. It did not go well...

Name: Golden Chalice
Description: A golden chalice that once held the Holy Grail. It is said that the chalice can grant immense power to those who drink from it, but it is also cursed with a terrible thirst.

Name: Heartstone Shard
Description: A mineral fragment that beats once when held still.

Name: Hexagonum
Description: The Hexagonum relic represents the natural world, since the hexagon is the considered the strongest shape and regularly found in nature.

Name: Infinitas
Description: Shaped like a circle, the Infinitas relic represents the never-ending struggle between good and evil.

Name: Joffrey's Letter
Description: A letter written from Joffrey to the waitress; maybe there is some use of this.

Name: Joker
Description: They say that Joker's are wild; you'll see how wild this one is.

Name: Kaelenon's Portal Key
Description: A glass-dark key printed from the Realm of Cambion terminal for Kaelenon's return home.

Name: Lucky Locket
Description: A simple gold necklace with a locket containing the picture of a fair lass.

Name: Luna
Description: The Moon, our celestial partner, is the inspiration for the Luna relic and represents love for others.

Name: Polaris
Description: The Polaris relic resembles the shape of a star and represents the guiding light of the North Star.

Name: Quadrata
Description: The Quadrata relic symbolizes order, trust, stability, and logic, the hallmarks of a well-balanced person.

Name: Serpent Venom Heart
Description: A pulsing knot of venom that refuses to die.

Name: Spring Water
Description: A vial of the finest spring water.

Name: Stormglass Feather
Description: A translucent feather with lightning trapped along its spine.

Name: Thieves Guild Signet
Description: A blackened silver signet taken from the guild's hidden initiation trial.

Name: Triangulus
Description: The holy trinity of mind, body, and spirit are represented by the Triangulus relic.

Name: Unobtainium
Description: The legendary ore that has only been theorized. Can be used to create ultimate weapons.

Name: Verdant Seed
Description: A sleeping seed warm with impossible spring.

Name: Blacksmith's Hammer
Description: It looks like a normal blacksmithing hammer but something seems...special about this one.

Name: Chiryu Koma
Description: A game piece used for shogi, depicting an earth dragon.

Name: Lockpick Kit
Description: A compact set of picks, tension wrenches, and shims required to use lockpicking skills. Durability: 3.

Name: Monocane
Description: A hollow gentleman's cane used to cast Sleeping Powder. Uses remaining: 5.

Name: Smoke Bomb
Description: A packed clay pellet that bursts into concealing smoke. Required and consumed by Smoke Screen.

Name: Water Bladder
Description: Carries ten restorative sips of water. Sips remaining: 10.

Name: Amatoxin
Description: Standard: Severe poison with a chance to enfeeble. Severe: Critical poison that can kill in five turns if not cured.

Name: Hemotoxin
Description: Standard: Moderate poison with a chance to blind. Severe: Severe poison and hemorrhaging.

Name: Mild Toxin
Description: Standard: Mild poison. Severe: Moderate poison.

Name: Myotoxin
Description: Standard: Severe poison with a chance to stun. Severe: Critical poison that can petrify in three turns if not cured.

Name: Necrotoxin
Description: Standard: Severe poison with a chance to incapacitate. Severe: Critical poison that can kill in two turns if not cured.

Name: Neurotoxin
Description: Standard: Mild poison with a chance to numb and disarm. Severe: Moderate poison and anaphylaxis, causing damage and silence.

Name: Deathcap Mushroom
Description: A toxin reagent used to make Amatoxin.

Name: Lizard Venom
Description: A toxin reagent used to make Myotoxin.

Name: Scorpion Venom
Description: A toxin reagent used to make Neurotoxin.

Name: Shadow Venom
Description: A toxin reagent used to make Necrotoxin.

Name: Snake Venom
Description: A toxin reagent used to make Mild Toxin.

Name: Viper Venom
Description: A toxin reagent used to make Hemotoxin.
